items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charlie Chaplin’s studios. That’s where A&M was.

ctx.x: So you did those records with ECM, and then you got this deal now with Horizon.
That’s the big time. Herb Alpert’s office. Charlie Chaplin’s studios. That’s where A&M was. Still is. La Brea Avenue in L.A. Expense account. I still owe them $98,000. Let’s put it that way.
All record companies tell you that.
